title: Editing and deleting comments — try it

steps.path: File button (top right) → 2026-09-24-onboarding-redesign.md → Comments button → hover a comment's header row
steps.headline: Hover a comment: Edit and Delete icons appear next to the Resolve toggle, same spot in every theme.
steps.notice: They stay hidden until you hover — try Light too with the theme switch above the pane. On a phone or touch screen they show all the time, since there's no hover to reveal them.
steps.risk: A touch screen shows the icons at rest, so the row reads slightly busier there than on desktop.

steps.path: Same comment panel → hover a reply (indented, under its comment — the one with Claude's answer)
steps.headline: A reply gets its own Edit and Delete icons, the same way, scoped to just that reply.
steps.notice: Editing or deleting a reply never touches the comment above it or any other reply.

steps.path: Click the pencil (Edit) icon on any comment or reply
steps.headline: Edit swaps the text for a box you can type in — Enter saves, Escape cancels.
steps.notice: Save/Cancel sit at the bottom right, like every other confirm in the app. There's no "edited" marker afterward.

steps.path: Click the trash (Delete) icon on the FIRST comment of the thread that already has Claude's reply
steps.headline: Delete asks first, and names how many replies go with it — deleting a thread's first comment deletes the whole thread.
steps.notice: Cancel backs out with nothing changed; Delete removes the comment and every reply under it in one go.
steps.risk: Deleting a REPLY instead only asks about that one reply ("Delete this reply?") — the thread above it stays.
